title: Canto X
wikitext:
'''Canto X: The Gaze Bearing''' is the tenth main story chapter of Limbus Company and the focus chapter of [[Meursault]]. It released in three weekly parts starting September 17, 2026, as the story chapter of [[Season 8: PUNCTUM]], and follows [[Intervallo VII: Mnestic Experience]]. It is set in N Corp.'s District 14, mostly inside the [[Grand Magasin Sisyphe]]. Unlike earlier chapters, it can be played early once Canto I is cleared, with a spoiler warning and temporary level boosts.

== Summary ==
After Meursault's arrest, a retrial is held. [[Faust]], acting as his defense with Sinclair, argues that he should receive the Sisyphe Penalty for killing his mother, one of the Sisyphean Giants. Meursault is hanged with a strange noose and his body is taken away. Faust then reveals a deal with the New [[League of Nine]]: their help rescuing Meursault and reaching the next Golden Bough, which lies inside the Grand Magasin Sisyphe, a virtual department store that N Corp. uses to produce its Canned Experiences.

== Ataraxie ==
The Sinners enter the Sisyphe through an N Corp. booth. Only Meursault entered the conventional way, so he alone can fully interact with the store; Dante guides him while the other Sinners rotate in pairs. A mysterious woman in blue undoes his deaths, and [[Jeanne]], a Giant and Meursault's former lover, guides the group over the intercom. The Sinners side with Le Noir against Le Rouge, forge a Golden Nail, and kill the newborn Crimson God. The Noir take control, everyone inside turns into tree-like beings, and time rewinds.

== Bon Appétit ==
Only Dante, Meursault and the Lady of the Fount remember the first loop. Jeanne explains the Liquidation: when the Sisyphe can no longer produce Canned Experiences, it resets everyone's memories. This time the Sinners help Le Rouge escort their reborn god, a child named Pwie, to the fifth-floor Restaurant while [[Carmen]]'s influence creates a third faction, the Néants. Pwie awakens as the ever-hungry Buffet, consumes the store, and a second Liquidation follows.

== Cogito ==
Dante ignores the Lady of the Fount's warning and tells the Sinners about the Liquidations. Kromer's older sister, who turns out to be the fourth Giant and the Voice of the Néants, explains that both earlier endings were planned by the Giants. The Sinners defeat the Warden, an avatar of the Chaplain, and then the Chaplain himself, whom Meursault refuses to repent to because his mother had Distorted and asked him to free her. They free Pwie from Buffet's form, and on the rooftop Meursault confronts the Distorted Jeanne, the current Architect, and pries the Golden Bough from her body.

== Aftermath ==
Carmen speaks to Dante face to face for the first time and points them toward the Library. The Sinners wake after three months inside the simulation. The Sisyphe's 300 million Distorted prisoners pour out and are incinerated, and the smoke falls on N Corp. as a crimson Sisyphean Rain. [[Heinrich Kromer]] stabs Maurice, the Chaplain's true self, and Kromer later pushes the N Corp. board toward a new crusade, while Hermann's group collects clues about the Protoplast.
